items.title: Owlflics of the Week
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic fans, Happy Thanksgiving eve! The football team closed out their 2026 home campaign undefeated inside Flagler Credit Union Stadium! Enjoy this week's edition of "OWLFLICS", presented by Baptist Health South Florida, showcasing the Owls' top photos of the week.

items.title: Inside the Owls’ Burrow S11, E15
items.summary: Inside the Owls' Burrow, the official weekly television show for Florida Atlantic Athletics, will air episode 15 of season 11 this week on Thursday, Nov. 26. Every 30-minute show this season will air on The Spot stations in the South Florida market.

items.title: Football Game Notes #12
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's 2026 regular season concludes on the road at East Carolina. Saturday's kickoff is set for 1 p.m. on ESPN+ and Fox Sports South Florida 640.

items.title: Schovanec a Broyles Award Nominee: Online Voting Now Open
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's Special Teams Coordinator Tyler Schovanec was announced on Tuesday as a nominee for the Broyles Award, bestowed annually to the top assistant coach in college football. Fans can vote online HERE.

items.title: Valsin Garners Second Tyler Rose Award Honorable Mention
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – For the second time in 2026, Florida Atlantic football's senior WR Kelby Valsin has been named an Earl Campbell Tyler Rose Player of the Week honorable mention, announced by the organization on Tuesday.

items.title: Henry and Johnson Joining Kittley for ESPN+ Presser
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic's Hagerty Family Head Football Coach Zach Kittley will be accompanied by fifth-year WR Dominique Henry and senior LB Khmari Johnson for the Tuesday, Nov. 24 press conference, airing live on ESPN+ at 12 p.m.

items.title: CBS Sports Recognizes Kittley After Triumphant South Florida Win
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic's Hagerty Family Head Football Coach Zach Kittley was selected by CBS Sports as an American Conference Coach of the Week, his fourth recognition this season and fifth in the last two seasons.

items.title: Veltkamp Named American Honorable Mention After Record Day
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's graduate QB Caden Veltkamp was recognized by the American Conference as a weekly honorable mention following his standout performance in a 35-14 win over South Florida.

items.title: Owls Finish Undefeated at Home After Program’s Longest Game
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's longest game in program history, 5 hours and 58 minutes, ended with a 35-14 victory over South Florida and the team's first 6-0 mark on Howard Schnellenberger Field at Flagler Credit Union Stadium.

items.title: Know Before You Go: Football Senior Day vs. South Florida
items.summary: BOCA RATON, Fla. – Florida Atlantic football's 2026 regular season home finale is set for Saturday, Nov. 21 against South Florida. Kickoff on Howard Schnellenberger Field at Flagler Credit Union Stadium is set for 2:30 p.m. on ESPN+.
